responsibility: Defines the public ABI-facing common unwinder interface for ARM EABI and C6X targets, including _Unwind_Control_Block layout, unwind reason/state/result enums, virtual register set classes and data representations, personality-routine types, VRS accessors, exception-propagation entry points, backtrace hooks, and GNU helper declarations such as __gnu_unwind_frame and __gnu_unwind_execute. This header owns the target-specific data structures and function prototypes that language runtimes, personality routines, and libgcc unwinder code share to describe and manipulate ARM-style stack unwinding state.
